item.text:
Removed the broad `aria-live` region around the app, which was being updated during project row refreshes and could destabilize the Open button.

Verified `node --check server.js`, health returned HTTP 200 with `{"status":"ok"}`, project creation trimmed its name, and the project list page loaded. The working tree is clean.
